messages.subject: Error with mplus2lavaan: v_post.match[1L] > 0 is not TRUE
parts: From what I can tell from the comments written in around line 68 here, this error has something to do with how model constraints are specified in the Mplus syntax file, where the use of hyphens (e.g., x1-x3* instead of x1* x2* x3*) confuses lavaan. I have over 2 million Mplus syntax files that I'd rather not rewrite. Is there a way around this error? I've attached an example of my syntax. Thanks!
